about: Italy: Autostrada Pedemontana Lombarda's unit toll rates per km for 2025 (euro, VAT excluded), plain stretches (it has no mountain ones), by its own free-flow classes, as its sheet published by the Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport (MIT, Direzione generale per le autostrade) states them. Transcribed by hand from the PDF; tools/tables says if the PDF has changed (sha256). Classes: 1 motorcycles and cars, 2 cars with trailer and vans, 3 vans, trucks and buses (Furgoni, Camion e Pullman), 4 articulated trucks and class 3 with trailer (TIR e veicoli di classe 3 con rimorchio). anas is the ANAS surcharge per km the sheet gives (Quota ANAS); VAT 22%. Stretches: A36-A, A36-B1, A59, A60.
